summary: RSS Feeds for Last.fm is a lightweight Node.js service that creates RSS feeds from a Last.fm user's listening history. It runs as a web‑frontend offering both an HTTP API and a CLI, built on standard Node.js libraries. It is suited for users who want to integrate their music data into any RSS reader or downstream workflow. The standout strength is its dual API/CLI access, while the main caveat is the lack of automated test coverage and limited community signals.
